scraped_replies.html:
See this thread, and this - ST do not generally provide 3D models for evaluation boards.

 

Why do you "need" a 3D model?

As noted in the above threads, ST Evaluation boards are not for use in final products - see here and here.

 

#3Dmodel

 

PS:

Another: https://community.st.com/t5/power-management/3d-request-missing-information-x-nucleo-ihm04a1/m-p/793452/highlight/true#M13618

 

Although, as explained above, ST do not generally provide 3D models for evaluation boards, there are a number of 3rd-parties who have created their own - so you might try a wider internet search ...

eg, here.
